repo.description: The repository (DID or handle) whose graph edges to list.

edgeType.description: Filter to edges with this edge type slug.

source.description: Filter to edges whose source node is this AT-URI.

target.description: Filter to edges whose target node is this AT-URI.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return in one page.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response, to resume after the last returned record.

records.description: The page of graph edge records returned.

uri.description: AT-URI of this graph edge record.

cid.description: CID of this graph edge record's indexed revision.
